name: Bar chart
purpose: Categorical comparison as vertical columns or horizontal bars — the round-one dataviz kit's bar family graduated into canon. Semantic SVG in the DOM, styled by tokens, animated by CSS, described by a real table (the ratified dataviz method). PROVISIONAL-AGENT: promoted from the PARKED kit (9 review rounds, not signed off); every value is OBSERVED kit geometry unless receipted as newly judged.

props.name: orientation
props.$note: column = vertical (negatives permitted by dv-bar-007); bar = horizontal (positives only — dv-bar-007 blocks negative horizontals).

props.name: series
props.$note: categorical = data/series/1–5 (mode-stable isoluminant set, R-D9); status = the salience RAMP red › amber › green › blue on rag/* (R-D9 — loudness tracks severity; NEVER the isoluminant set for status).

props.name: data
props.$note: A real <table class="dv-table"> inside the figure — the a11y spine AND the tabular alternative (dv-005). Surfaced by a native <details> disclosure (zero JS).

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state consumes the Empty-state pattern by reference: dashed frame, title carries the meaning, no glyph (spot-illustration set is a logged icon gap).

variants.name: column categorical
variants.use: Compare categories; single series keeps ONE colour across every chart of the same data (dv-014).

variants.name: bar categorical
variants.use: Long category names / many categories; same data = same series colour as the column (journey consistency).

variants.name: column status
variants.use: Counts by state (R-D9 ramp order, direct-labelled — the status word sits under each bar, colour never alone R-D6 A′).

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — axis ticks + table .t-cm-legal (kit's 11px promoted to the 12px KB step, DV-D05) · category labels .t-cm-caption
tokens.series-categorical: data/series/1–5 — mode-stable candidate C (V7 RULED); ≥3.17:1 vs both mode surfaces
tokens.series-status: rag/error · rag/warning (graphic-grade #C58900, R-D3) · rag/success · rag/information — R-D9's resolved ramp greens/blues are NOT yet token-promoted (receipted gap)
tokens.axis: text/default at 0.6 alpha (house treatment; effective ≈4.6:1 light / 5.5:1 dark) — kit's #545454/#9B9B9B have no post-R-D16 semantic home
tokens.gridlines: text/default at per-mode alpha .10/.16 (reproduces the kit's reviewed quiet grid; data/grid role token = receipted gap; gridline contrast is ADVISORY by DV-D03)
tokens.surface: background/default (charts sit on the page, data-surface="page")
tokens.$survey: Promoted from _proforma/DataViz-interactive.html (PARKED, fence intact); Empty-state + Stat-card conventions consumed by reference.

motion.entry: Bars grow from the baseline (scaleY/scaleX, transform-box:fill-box), 760ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), 45ms stagger — kit-reviewed values, CSS only (DEF-003).
motion.hover: brightness(1.12) light / (1.22) dark emphasis; <title> carries the value natively.
motion.reducedMotion: Entry animation is inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference; global collapse also present.

responsive.rule: DV-D02: compress width, NEVER scale proportionally — text must not scale. Static answer: fixed 580×260 geometry + horizontal scroll in .dv-stage. The kit's runtime fit() relayout is JS Layer-2, not promoted.

mustNotNeighbour: A Stat-card making the identical claim in the same view
A second chart re-using these series colours for DIFFERENT data (dv-014)

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="img" with a full-sentence data aria-label.
accessibility.name: The figcaption names the chart; the svg aria-label reads the data; each rect carries a <title>.
accessibility.keyboard: Only the <details> summary is focusable (native disclosure); the figure itself is passive.
accessibility.nonText: Series fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (dv-016 BLOCKING, computed from resolved values); status meaning carried by the label under each bar, never colour alone (R-D6 A′, direct-labelled).

antiPatterns: Status data on the isoluminant categorical set (R-D9: status is a salience RAMP)
Negative values on a horizontal bar (dv-bar-007 — verticals only)
Raw hex series fills (dv-017 — var() tokens only)
More than one chevron pattern, or chevron outside gauges (DV-D04)
A chart without its real data table (dv-005)
Scaling the whole SVG down responsively (DV-D02 — text must never scale)

tokenValidation.result: PASS — series 1–5 ≥3.17:1 both modes; status fills ≥3:1 both modes (amber = graphic-grade #C58900 by design, R-D3); axis effective ≈4.6/5.5:1; ink 17.4:1.
